+#summary Call R code from Java
+#sidebar UserSideBar
+
+= Introduction =
+
+The best way to call R from Java is to use the javax.scripting interfaces.
These interfaces are mature and gauranteed to be stable regardless of how
Renjin's internals evolve.
+
+== Creating the Scripting Engine ==
+
+{{{
+// create a script engine manager
+ScriptEngineManager factory = new ScriptEngineManager();
+
+// create an R engine
+ScriptEngine engine = factory.getEngineByName("Renjin");
+
+// evaluate JavaScript code from String
+engine.eval("print('Hello, World')");
+
+}}}
